title: 404 error occurs after refreshing from intercepted parallel route.

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: Linking and Navigating
labels.description: Related to Next.js linking (e.g., <Link>) and navigation.

body:
### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://github.com/aramikuto/nextjs-intercepted-parallel-route-refresh-problem

### To Reproduce

1. Navigate to the intercepted parallel route.
2. Press the `Refresh` button.

### Current vs. Expected behavior

I expected the `router.refresh` function to update the content of the displayed components without altering which components are being displayed. However, upon refreshing, the content of the root page (`/`) is replaced with a 404 error page.

https://github.com/vercel/next.js/assets/116561995/681d0f5f-eb62-434b-a3eb-eeb2e021ee98

### Provide environment information

```bash
Operating System:
  Platform: darwin
  Arch: arm64
  Version: Darwin Kernel Version 23.3.0: Wed Dec 20 21:30:27 PST 2023; root:xnu-10002.81.5~7/RELEASE_ARM64_T8103
Binaries:
  Node: 18.19.0
  npm: 10.2.3
  Yarn: 1.22.21
  pnpm: 8.14.3
Relevant Packages:
  next: 14.1.1-canary.59 // Latest available version is detected (14.1.1-canary.59).
  eslint-config-next: N/A
  react: 18.2.0
  react-dom: 18.2.0
  typescript: 5.1.3
Next.js Config:
  output: N/A
```


### Which area(s) are affected? (Select all that apply)

App Router, Routing (next/router, next/navigation, next/link)

### Which stage(s) are affected? (Select all that apply)

next dev (local), next start (local)

### Additional context

In version 14.0.1, refreshing does not trigger a 'not found' error and successfully updates the displayed components as expected.
